content: संचारिन् {%a.%} (-णी|{%f.%}) .²1 Moving, moveable; संचारिणी नगरदेवतेव <ls>Māl. 1</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 54</ls>; संचारिणी दीपशिखेव रात्रौ <ls>R. 6. 67</ls>. .²2 Roaming, wandering. .²3 Changing, unsteady, fickle. .²4 Difficult to be passed, inaccessible. .²5 Evanescent, as a Bhāva; see below. .²6 Influencing. .²7 Hereditary, successively communicated (as a disease). .²8 Contagious. .²9 Impelling. --{%m.%} .²1 Wind, air. .²2 Incense. .²3 A transient or evanescent feeling which serves to strengthen the prevailing sentiment; see व्यभिचारिन्.
